title: Capacity review for a six-hour project
summary: The chosen weekday evening windows contain four available hours after recorded commitments and breaks. The six-hour estimate exceeds that capacity by two hours; reduce scope or extend the timeline. No time has been booked.
assumptions: This fictional example uses user-confirmed Monday to Friday 18:00–20:00 work windows and a 15-minute break allowance per window.
limitations: The complete six-hour goal does not fit the reviewed period.

deferred: Two hours of estimated work require a later week or an explicit change of availability.
